summary: The pattern deliberately composes established approaches to living, versioned and navigable system knowledge; the Companion App is a product-shaped integration, not a claim of invention.

items.text: Cyrille Martraire, Living Documentation — documentation evolves with the code through well-crafted artifacts and automation.
Write the Docs, Docs as Code — version control, plain text, reviews and automated tests apply software workflows to documentation.
Simon Brown, C4 model — hierarchical diagrams provide different zoom levels for different audiences.
ISO/IEC 13250-2:2006 — the current Topic Maps data model defines structure, interpretation and merging rules.
W3C RDF 1.1 Concepts — a standard graph data model underlying many knowledge-graph implementations.
Michael Nygard, Documenting Architecture Decisions — small repository-local records preserve forces, decisions, status and consequences.
Agent Studio operational evidence — Wiki Pulse, drift grading, Quality Review and target-state consolidation exercise the integrated pattern.
